rca_multi_independent.root_cause: VIAF adapter emits independent viaf-* Findings with single-family Evidence; orchestrator does not merge/corroborate cross-family Evidence onto the same FindingId. Therefore hostFamilyCount stays 1 for every Finding → multi_independent_rate=0 despite viaf present at session level.

rca_multi_independent.next: HOLD promote. Optional follow-up (out of Acc scope): Finding join key across viaf↔wikidata↔wikipedia (e.g. VIAF↔WD external-id) before re-measure.
